DESIGN_NOTE: V3 GPU port of depth-scaling cell. Per Fix #24 GPU mandate: torch.cuda + batched candidate scoring (V_C backward states computed in one matmul instead of V_C separate matvecs); encoder + W hoisted per seed; empty_cache between depths. Semantics identical to numpy v3 (same arms / depths / seeds / HARD_PASS conditions / bands). T13 self-test verifies batched-vs-loop equivalence to <1e-4. v1/v2 ran depth=5 and chain-graded BIDIR_MEET_MID=0.620 (cv=0.064). V3 tests sqrt-style scaling at d in {3,5,7,9}, ARM_FORWARD_HALF_DEPTH (meeting > shorter), ARM_RANDOM_MEET_BASELINE (true midpoint matters), ARM_MULTISCALE_BIDIRECTIONAL (scale-invariance), ARM_META_M7_RAIL_REPLICATE/_BIDIR (regime-drift). 5 seeds for depth-scaling stability. Per drill 2026-06-27 HARD_PASS requires: (1) bidir d=9 >= 0.45 (2) bidir >= fwd_half + 0.10 EVERY depth (3) bidir >= random + 0.15 EVERY depth (4) m7_bidir d=5 >= 0.60.
